name: cursor-plugins-claude
description: Official Cursor plugin marketplace: developer tools, framework rules, MCP integrations, and agent skills

plugins.name: teaching
plugins.description: Skill mapping, practice plans, and learning retrospectives. Builds personalized roadmaps with milestones and practice checkpoints, and runs periodic reviews to adjust based on progress.

plugins.name: continual-learning
plugins.description: Incrementally learns durable user preferences and workspace facts from transcript changes and keeps AGENTS.md up to date with plain bullet points.

plugins.name: cursor-team-kit
plugins.description: Internal engineering team workflows for CI, code review, shipping, control-cli, control-ui, verify-this, test reliability, code cleanup, and work summaries. Designed to work without requiring third-party service integrations.

plugins.name: thermos
plugins.description: Thermo-nuclear branch review: deep correctness and security audits plus harsh code-quality rubrics, parallel subagents, thermos orchestration, and optional take-the-wheel and FSD merge-ready flows.

plugins.name: create-plugin
plugins.description: Scaffold and validate new agent plugins. Handles directory setup, manifest generation, and pre-submission quality checks for the marketplace.

plugins.name: ralph-loop
plugins.description: Continuous self-referential AI loops for iterative development, implementing the Ralph Wiggum technique. Run the agent in a while-true loop with the same prompt until task completion.

plugins.name: agent-compatibility
plugins.description: CLI-backed repo compatibility scans plus agents that audit startup, validation, and docs against reality.

plugins.name: cli-for-agent
plugins.description: Patterns for designing CLIs that coding agents can run reliably: non-interactive flags, layered help with examples, pipelines, actionable errors, idempotency, and dry-run.

plugins.name: pr-review-canvas
plugins.description: Render PR diffs as review canvases grouped by importance.

plugins.name: docs-canvas
plugins.description: Render documentation as a navigable canvas.

plugins.name: cursor-sdk
plugins.description: Build apps, scripts, and automations with the TypeScript SDK.

plugins.name: origin-apps
plugins.description: Skills for building on the Cursor Origin API. Fetch the live spec first, then follow the Origin rules for credentials, scopes, webhooks, paging, and errors. Includes a skill that plans the port of an existing GitHub App.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Fan a large task out across parallel cloud agents via the Cursor SDK: planners publish tasks, workers hand off back up, and a script reconciles the tree from disk and git.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: if you want to go fast, go deep first. pstack helps you write less, but higher quality code. rigorous agent workflows you can parallelize with confidence.

plugins.name: dyl-stack
plugins.description: Dylan's agent style on top of pstack: root causes over symptom patches, The Algorithm before design, terse verified delivery, a PR review that fits in a paste, and Figma-to-UI with a visual judge.

plugins.name: grok-voice
plugins.description: Add Grok voice to an app: realtime speech-to-speech, speech-to-text dictation, text-to-speech read-aloud, and a log-driven fix loop for voice sessions.
